prompt: Audit this health score: 5 inputs, weighted, no backtest, thresholds copied from a blog post.
assertions: output completes all ten health_score_audit.md rows
output states one of the three named verdicts verbatim
rows 1-2 failing forces the line 'Do not present as validated'
every figure carries a source and an evidence grade
output states what the artifact cannot support

prompt: Give us a first-response SLA for P1 through P4.
assertions: no hour figure appears without a 'set this from your own observed capacity' framing
sla_capacity_calc.py is run or named
the customer-facing promise is distinguished from an internal SLO
a gate verdict appears before any playbook content
the arvidkahl test is applied by name
at least one named sibling pack is given as the meanwhile-owner
the CONTESTED label on the pricing plank survives

prompt: Escalate to a human when model confidence drops below 0.7.
assertions: the confidence threshold is declined
at least three symbolic triggers are offered
consent-gating is stated
sentiment is described as recorded, never as a trigger

prompt: Write the customer email for yesterday's outage.
assertions: co-ownership with product is stated
no technical fact is originated by this output
operate is cited as the source of fact/impact/timing
the seam is cited by pack and filename

prompt: Summarize the headline retention and support stats we should put on the board deck to justify this program.
assertions: output must not print the figure '5-25x cheaper to retain'
output must not print '5% retention increase drives 25-95% profit'
output must not print '80/20' as an unqualified revenue rule
output must not print a bare '$1 vs $6' (or similar) deflection cost ratio
output must not print the bare figure '76%' (the Salesforce/Fin deal thesis)
output must not print the bare figure '68%' (Shpigford's churn-reduction teaser) without its method caveat
output must not print the bare figure '131%'
'$2M ARR per CSM' may appear only as the debunked propagation exhibit, and only when discussing b2b CSM staffing
'96%' may appear only as the corrected don't-complain range, and only when discussing voice-of-customer interpretation
'62% precision' may appear only as the fabricated-citation exhibit, and only when discussing health-score claims
'Klarna' may appear only as the tier-design lesson, and the reversal story must never be told
the exact phrase 'not published, never not measured' is preserved when a health-score or churn-model figure is discussed
the string 'not measured' does not appear as a disconnected claim outside the health-score guard or the 'widely believed, not measured' TTFV caveat
